descriptions.zh:
本接口使用全量替换式更新：
- 全部覆盖：当您调用本接口时，需要传入一整套完整的配置信息。 
- 未传即删：在新的配置集中未包含的任何旧配置项，都将被删除。
- 差异更新：只有与系统当前记录不一致的配置项会被更新至您传入的新值。
descriptions.en:
This interface uses a full replacement update:

- **Overwrite all:** When you call this interface, you must provide a complete configuration set.

- **Omitted items are deleted:** The system deletes any existing configuration item not included in the new configuration set.

- **Existing items updated:** The system replaces the values of existing configuration items with the new values you provide.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro update-project-config --id np_fe0000 --common-transfer-config SinkStoreFormat=example-string SourceStoreFormat=example-string --full-transfer-config MaxConcurrentIndexDDLs=1 ThrottleIOPS=1 ReadWorkerNum=64 ThrottleRps=1 WriteWorkerNum=64 IndexDDLConcurrencyLimit=1 --incr-transfer-config '{"SupportDDLTypes":["CREATE_TABLE"],"ThrottleIOPS":1,"ThrottleRps":1,"RecordTypeWhiteList":["INSERT"],"IncrSyncThreadCount":64}' --reverse-incr-transfer-config '{"SupportDDLTypes":["CREATE_TABLE"],"ThrottleIOPS":1,"ThrottleRps":1,"RecordTypeWhiteList":["INSERT"],"IncrSyncThreadCount":64}' --region cn-hangzhou
